chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Hammawayh al-Suwaydawi, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, who said:

I doubted at the time of the passing of Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام), and a great amount of wealth had accumulated with my father. So he carried it and boarded the ship, and I went out with him seeing him off. Then he was struck with a severe illness, and he said: “O my son, take me back, for this is death.” And he said to me: “Be wary of Allah regarding this wealth,” and he entrusted me with his testament; then he died.

So I said to myself: “My father would not entrust anything that was not sound. I will carry this wealth to al-Iraq, rent a house on the riverbank, and not inform anyone of anything. If something becomes clear to me with the same clarity as it was in the days of Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام), I will carry it out; otherwise, I will cast it away.”

Then I came to al-Iraq and rented a house on the riverbank, and remained for some days. Then suddenly there came to me a note with a messenger, in which was: “O Muhammad, with you is such-and-such inside such-and-such,” until he enumerated to me all that was with me, including what I had not fully known myself. So I handed it over to the messenger. Then I remained for some days during which no recognition was shown to me, and I became distressed. Then there came out to me: “We have established you in the place of your father, so praise Allah.”

key_terms.اتَّقِ اللَّهَ: be conscious of Allah and act with piety
key_terms.الرَّسُولِ: the messenger who conveyed the note
key_terms.بِرُقْعَةٍ: with a written note or slip
key_terms.مَالٌ جَلِيلٌ: a large and significant amount of wealth
key_terms.مَكَانَ أَبِيكَ: in the place of your father

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith show the continuing authority of the Imam after the passing of Imam Abu Muhammad عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report narrates Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar’s uncertainty after the passing of Imam Abu Muhammad عليه السلام, and how he was guided through a written communication that precisely identified the entrusted wealth. The narration signifies the continuing authority and knowledge of the Imam and records the appointment of the son in his father’s place regarding that trust.
